However, the question asks what makes people happy when it is surprising and unexpected, and a joke is specifically structured around an unexpected twist or punchline. Answer 1 overemphasizes the abstract quality of humor while underplaying the concrete, surprise-driven nature of a joke. Answer 2 correctly identifies that a joke relies on surprise and unexpectedness to elicit happiness, while humor is the general quality and laughter is the reaction.
